description: Non-destructive enrichment of the 20 M2 Hue MVP records. Field evidence is not blanket verification of a place.
tagMethod: Manual MVP taxonomy based on the named attraction/food experience and M2 source descriptions; not an external rating or a verified travel measurement.

evidence.note: Portal lists Cung An Dinh admission at 50,000 VND/person, rather than the seed's 25,000. Does not verify the visit date's promotions, admission eligibility, opening hours or address.
Recommended visiting window only. The article explicitly says there are no fixed operating hours; do not convert this to openingHours or a hard constraint.

REST_H_09.basis: Published range for Che Cam at 10 Nguyen Sinh Cung; assumes one cup per person, a snack rather than a complete meal.
